process.title: How we work together
process.intro: Four clear steps – you always know what happens next.

call.title: Free first call
call.text: We talk about your business, goals and budget. Afterwards you get a concrete quote.

concept.title: Concept & design
concept.text: I plan the content and structure and show you the design before any code is written.

build.title: Build
build.text: I build the website, you review it on a preview address and give feedback.

launch.title: Launch & ads
launch.text: The website goes live; your Google profile and, if you like, Google Ads are set up.

about.title: Hi, I'm {name}.
text: I study in Duisburg and combine three things that usually take three different agencies: design, development and Google Ads.
I take on only one new project per month. That way you get my full attention – personally, in German or English.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Your question isn't here? Just write to me.

price.q: How much does a website cost?
price.a: It depends on the scope. The packages show starting prices. You get a fixed price after the free first call – no surprises.

timeline.q: How long does a project take?
timeline.a: It depends on the scope and on how quickly texts and images are ready. We set the schedule together in the first call.

hosting.q: Where will my website be hosted?
hosting.a: With a reliable provider we choose together – or with your existing provider. I tell you the running costs in advance.

changes.q: Can I change things after launch?
changes.a: Yes. I'm happy to make changes, regularly if you like. We'll discuss what works best in the first call.

language.q: Do you work in English too?
language.a: Yes. I work in German and English, and your website can be bilingual too.

contact.intro: Tell me briefly about your business and your plans. I'll get back to you personally.

cafe.title: Café Hafenbohne
cafe.summary: Website for a café: menu, opening hours and table booking.
cafe.problem: Guests only find opening hours and the menu on social media; bookings come in by phone only.
cafe.solution: A warm one-page website with menu, opening hours, directions and a booking form – optimised for phones.
cafe.goal: More bookings online, fewer calls at peak times and better visibility on Google Maps.

handwerk.title: Müller Elektro
handwerk.summary: Trust-focused website for an electrician with an emergency service.
handwerk.problem: The old website looks outdated, and the emergency number is hard to find on a phone.
handwerk.solution: A clear structure, an always-visible emergency button, services at a glance and a simple quote request.
handwerk.goal: More qualified enquiries from Duisburg and the area, and faster contact in an emergency.

export.title: Gaibandha Jute Co.
export.summary: B2B website for a jute exporter, English first.
export.problem: International buyers can't find product data, minimum order quantities or shipping terms.
export.solution: A product catalogue with specifications, MOQs and Incoterms, plus a structured enquiry form.
export.goal: Better enquiries from wholesalers worldwide – with everything needed for a fast quote.

luxury.title: Maison Noir Duft
luxury.summary: Cinematic brand website with a 3D bottle and a scroll story.
luxury.problem: A new fragrance brand needs a presence that feels premium and stays in people's minds.
luxury.solution: A dark, elegant site with a real 3D bottle that turns as you scroll, and a story in three chapters.
luxury.goal: A brand people talk about – and more requests for sample sets and wholesale.
